hero.title: One printer or a hundred. Your data. Your rules.
hero.subtitle: Self-hosted command center for Bambu Lab — friendly enough to start with one printer, powerful enough to run a print farm.

highlight.title: A print farm that runs itself
highlight.body: Drop a job into the queue and BamDude picks the right idle printer — by model, by AMS slots, by current load. Dispatch starts two, three, ten machines in parallel instead of one at a time. A1 swappers cycle plate after plate through swap-mode macros. G-code macros tick off the repetitive bits — chamber light, end-of-print sequences, calibration runs — without anyone watching. You set the rules once; the farm prints.

supportedPrinters.title: Supported printers
supportedPrinters.subtitle: Works with the full range of Bambu Lab printers via Developer Mode.

helpWanted.title: Build BamDude with us
helpWanted.body: BamDude is a small open-source project run by a print-farm operator who needed a tool that didn't exist yet. The features you see came from real farm-floor problems — there's plenty more on the list. Whatever angle you want in, there's room.

items.title: Code contributors
items.body: Pick an open issue, fix a bug, ship a feature. PRs land on the dev branch.

items.title: Feature ideas + testing
items.body: Run a beta tag on your farm, share what broke and what you wished worked differently. Real-world stress is the most valuable input.

items.title: Translators
items.body: JSON-driven i18n in both backend and frontend — adding a language is a single PR. Currently EN + UK; whatever language your local print shop talks, we'll take it.

items.title: Documentation help
items.body: docs.bamdude.top has its own repo. Found a stale instruction or a missing screenshot? Open a PR.
